debugData.description: p309 Phase 3's decal block: the terrain add-on's export (devTools/blender/buildDecalTest.py), 32 m / 65, a ridge 2.5 m high with ±0.25 m bumps about 5 m apart, mud01 through textureSetSurface's variant; its decal set terrainBlockTestDecals_decals (two tyre tracks curving over the ridge, asphaltDamage on its flank, a crack at its foot) spawns with it.
